# Unit test for function get_closest_vowel
def test_get_closest_vowel():
    assert get_closest_vowel("yogurt") == "u"
    assert get_closest_vowel("FULL STACK") == "A"
    assert get_closest_vowel("hello") == "e"
    assert get_closest_vowel("anime") == "i"

    # Vowels at the beginning or end do not qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("apple") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("Asia") == ""

    # Adjacent vowels do not qualify
    assert get_closest_vowel("quick") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("eeeee") == ""

    # Words shorter than three characters
    assert get_closest_vowel("") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("ab") == ""
